The prosecution says "故意伤害他人身体致人轻伤". So the crime is intentional injury (故意伤害). Possibly also "聚众斗殴"? But it's a dispute between individuals, not group. The description: "因故与本村席某甲发生争执，并引起打架，在打架过程中，被告人张某用撬杠将席某甲及其儿子席某丙、席某丁打伤". That's a single person using weapon to cause injuries. So the crime is "故意伤害". In Chinese criminal law, "故意伤害罪" includes causing light injury. So answer: [罪名]故意伤害<eoa>.
